VERDICT: FAIL

[HIGH] `quality-lead` exemption breaks the no-cascade guarantee.  
[quality-lead.md](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/.claude/agents/product/quality-lead.md:12) grants `Bash` and `Agent`, and [sprint-hook-points.json](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/.claude/agents/_org/sprint-hook-points.json:32) summons it at `design`. The enforcer exempts it in [consult-roster-no-dispatch.js](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/scripts/checks/consult-roster-no-dispatch.js:57), so the check exits green while a design consult role can still dispatch. `scopeContract` is not enough: [scope-contract-guard.js](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/scripts/hooks/scope-contract-guard.js:145) only gates `Agent` calls to build-chain/review roles and file-scope text; it does not remove `Bash`. `dispatch-route-guard` allows canonical `node scripts/dispatch-claude.js ...` / `dispatch-agent.js ...` wrappers at [dispatch-route-guard.js](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/scripts/hooks/dispatch-route-guard.js:81), so an exempt consult can still start build-chain or reviewer dispatch via Bash.  
Fix: split `quality-lead` into a read-only design consult spec with no `Bash`/`Agent` and a separate coordinator role for gauntlet fan-out, or add a real lineage/caller-aware hard gate that forbids `Bash` and restricts `Agent` to an explicit one-hop allowlist while in consult context.

[HIGH] Unreadable/missing consult specs false-green.  
[readSpecTools](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/scripts/checks/consult-roster-no-dispatch.js:64) returns an empty tool set on missing `specRel` or `readFileSync` failure, and [evaluate](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/scripts/checks/consult-roster-no-dispatch.js:113) treats that as clean. I verified a fixture with a design consult role pointing at `missing.md` returns `{"ok":true,"scanned":1}`. A hook row for an unknown role also returns green. This is directly spoofable/desync-prone for the claimed rename-proof guarantee.  
Fix: fail closed when a consult role is absent from the registry, lacks `spec`, has an unreadable spec, or has no parseable tools declaration. Add planted tests for each.

[MEDIUM] Tool parsing is ad hoc and can miss valid frontmatter forms.  
[readSpecTools](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/scripts/checks/consult-roster-no-dispatch.js:75) only parses same-line `tools:` or `(Tools: ...)`. A normal YAML block list can carry `Bash`/`Agent` without being detected.  
Fix: parse the YAML frontmatter structurally, or explicitly reject any consult spec whose `tools` field cannot be parsed into a confirmed set.

Confirmed: the `dispatch-contract` subset ceiling itself is intact. The narrow-only validator still rejects mode-profile widening at [dispatch-contract.js](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/scripts/dispatch/dispatch-contract.js:471), and `alpha_only_shapes: []` remains only an array-of-known-shapes annotation at [dispatch-contract.js](C:/Users/Vlad/Desktop/Claude/Projects/WarpOS/scripts/dispatch/dispatch-contract.js:522). `node scripts/dispatch/dispatch-contract.js validate` and `dispatch-contract.test.js` passed, including build-chain and cross-provider in-process rejection tests.
